text: During cheddaring the drained curd mats and fuses, which aligns the protein strands and gives a dense, close texture.

steps.note: The curd is heated, its temperature raised 0.2–0.5 °C a minute.
The whey is drawn off about two hours after the rennet, at pH 6.0–6.1.

steps.name: cheddar
steps.note: The curd is matted and fused into slabs.
The curd is salted dry, to 1.75–1.95 % salt.
The cheese is pressed into blocks of 18–20 kg.
